text:
maya.prod: Heads up 1: we completed the hybrid-batcher-v3 + kv-soft-evict rollout to production and flipped routing at 03:40 UTC. Early telemetry looks strong. p50 down from ~52ms -> ~31ms (-40%), p95 from ~310ms -> ~180ms (-42%), p99 from ~650ms -> ~420ms (-35%). Estimated token cost savings: ~22%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example.com/hybrid-batcher-v3

ian.runtime: Nice! Canary details?

maya.prod: Canary ran at 15% for 4.5 hours, then 50% for 2 hours with focused regression checks, and finally to 100% after green. Canary checks: error-rate, model output diffs on evalset, end-to-end latency percentiles. No customer-facing changes.

rui.eng: Summary of what changed: hybrid-batcher-v3 introduces adaptive windowing (short-window fast-path for small requests), better seq-aware packing, and a soft-evict policy for KV cache that preferentially keeps multi-tenant hot prefixes. Also swapped a hotpath mutex for optimistic RCU-like reader path. See /eng/changes/hybrid-batcher-v3/README.md for details and perf scripts.

kevin.sre: Observability notes 1: traces show reduced queueing in the scheduler; tail lock contention down ~60%. I created a temporary alert: if p99 > baseline * 1.2 for 20m -> page oncall. No increased error rates and no DB pressure.

olga.finance: Ops note 1: the cost model adjustment forecasts ~${"}30k/month" savings at current traffic, but depends on request mix. I'll post an updated forecast in the cost channel tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deploy finished by maya.prod at 03:40 UTC — changelog: hybrid-batcher-v3, kv-soft-evict, optimistic-reader-path. CI: green, smoke tests: passed, rolling restart complete.

sam.platform: What's the rollback plan if we see silent regressions on specific customers?

maya.prod: Rollback criteria: sustained error-rate >0.4% or sustained p99 increase >20% for 15m for any customer segment. Immediate mitigation: pin customer routing via route.filters: `route.variant="hybrid-batcher-v2"` or `route.customer_id=<id>`; we also have a rapid redeploy at codepath v2 build artifact.

rui.eng: Bench snippet we used (perf rig):```bash
wrk -t12 -c200 -d120s -s scripts/hybrid_bench.lua https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
``` Results in /perf/2026-04/hybrid-v3. Notes: use keyset `perf-hybrid` and run with seq-length=64 for comparable numbers.

kevin.sre: Post-deploy housekeeping: extended retention for traces around the rollout window (03:20-04:10 UTC) and added a short-run job to diff output quality on the canonical evalset every hour for 24h.

maya.prod: Thanks to everyone who shipped this. Next steps: follow-up PRs to tune soft-evict thresholds (#1021) and a short internal doc on when to prefer hybrid-batcher vs compact-path for dedicated workloads. If you spot anomalies, ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :rocket:
